Results.ReviewText: After a few uses, this kettle grill is light weight, perfect size, and very easy to maintain. The grill holds up to a large amount of food and is very easy to manage. The for the size and stability you can get great use out of it.

Results.ReviewText: I just got the SALUTE TO SERVICE KETTLE today at Home Depot this evening. I absolutely love it.  Only thing i do wish if it had a thermometer on it.  Otherwise i cant wait to use it.
Results.Title: Brand new kettle to my collection

Results.ReviewText: Now that summer is now here I’ve been enjoying grilling some meat and having some amazing family time. This charcoal grill is so easy to assemble and clean. It’s incredibly useful and great for a quick meal.
Results.Title: Small but mighty

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and great customer service! Love the quality of the grill. I had the grate lose a few welds and Weber sent me a new great fast!
Results.Title: Weber 22”

Results.ReviewText: Classic for a reason.  It does not have bells and whistles because you don’t need them.
Results.Title: Must have

Results.ReviewText: Heaven in a kettle. I love it so far, two decades of gas grilling was a waste. Hank Hill can eat his heart out because I like tasting the heat and the meat.

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill! I had forgotten how good food cooked with charcoal tasted. This grill is very versatile. The only thing I can’t quite get the hang of is hanging the lid on the edge of the grill. I have to kind look for the hook as it attaches to the grill’s edge. It hangs well but takes a moment to get it right. I love the ash catcher and the rotating holes in which the ashes fall into the catcher. So easy and mess free!
Results.Title: Love the grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: We’re obsessed. Weber has always been tried and true for us. Love that it’s taller so we don’t have to keep bending down. The size is perfect too. We’ve done hot dogs and steaks already!
Results.Title: Perfect for everyday

Results.ReviewText: This is my first charcoal grill and so far I’m really enjoying using it. It was very easy to assemble and seems very sturdy and durable. The vents help me regulate the heat easily and I’ve been getting a nice smoky flavor on everything I’ve grilled so far. The wheels are nice so I can move it around to store it. The grilling surface has plenty of space and I really like that you can hang the lid off of the side.
Results.Title: Very easy to use

Results.ReviewText: Got this grill because the 22” stealth wasn’t big enough for holidays or parties. All components were perfect and the dark green looks amazing!
Results.Title: 22” Salute To Service Kettle

Results.ReviewText:
This is one of the best grills I have owned.  I gave only three stars because of some flaws.  The one-touch cleaning system is too flimsy; mine has shed two of the three "petals", significantly limiting my control of the airflow.  The other flaw is worse.  The cooking grate is chrome plated steel.  That is a stupid choice of material.  The chrome flakes off into the food over time, leading to corrosion of the underlying steel.  Worse, I'm feeding chrome flakes to my family.  I accessed Weber's parts list online, looking for a stainless steel grate.  Weber doesn't even make one.  I'll have to resort to an aftermarket grate.

Weber's classic bowl design is so well designed and well manufactured, it's a mystery to me why they would put such a cheap piece of garbage as their grate in their signature grill.  A mystery and a disappointment.
Results.Title: Mixed review

Results.ReviewText: I own three of these BQs and it’s the best design for smoking and heat distribution.
Results.Title: Great BQ

Results.ReviewText: It was a gift... the beans and rice keep falling through the grill
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: I've been really happy with the Weber Original Kettle 22. Setup was quick and easy, and it's very simple to use once you get cooking. It holds heat well and gives food that real smoky charcoal flavor. Burgers, steaks, and chicken all come out great. Solid grill that feels like it'll last for years.
Results.Title: I love it

Photos.Caption: There is a hook inside the lid to hang it

Results.ReviewText: This Weber Grill  is easy to use and makes barbecuing anything very easy.. It was easy to assemble following the instructions and illustrations. It also came with a 10 year limited warranty.   The Weber grill is easy to move around my yard because it has wheels.  There are vents on the top and the bottom of the grill to control the heat and a tray at the bottom of the grill too let out the used charcoal ash.  It looks really good and I enjoy barbecuing on it at least twice a week.  It is built very well and it is sturdy and strong.  It is a safe grill for. Folks that are learning to grill.  It is a well-known American favorite grill. I highly recommend it.
Results.Title: The Weber grill is easy to assemble and built well

Results.ReviewText: I have had a few Weber kettle grills and they have always worked flawlessly. I really appreciate the newer design features like the heat shield on the lid handle and the hooks molded into the handle for hanging tongs and spatulas.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always wanted a charcoal grill and this fits the bill perfectly.  I am challenged with the concepts of charcoal cooking but getting better at it each time I use it.  Nothing like the original!
Results.Title: Finally got my first charcoal grill—and I love it.

Results.ReviewText: We've been enjoying this Weber charcoal grill so far. I love that it's on wheels and it's lightweight so it's easy to move around. It's nice that we can just throw it in the back of the truck and take it with us whenever we need. It's great for picnics and tailgating and we can't wait to take it camping one day. It heat up nice and evenly and so far everything we've eaten from the grill has been yummy!
Results.Title: Portable

Results.ReviewText: This military edition is very sharp.  I got the cover so I can keep it as nice as possible for as long as I can.  First two grills confirm the design is terrific to get a fire going, using vents to control temps, and cooking both direct and indirect very well.  I am extremely pleased with this purchase.
Results.Title: Really great design

Results.ReviewText: This 22” weber kettle grill has easily become my go to grill, I used to be intimidated by charcoal grilling, but honestly, it’s not that complicated. It only takes a little more time to get started and the flavor is far superior to electric grills. The grates have been easy to clean and it lightweight and portable which is a huge plus for me. A couple downsides to me are the ash catcher doesn’t always catch ash or hot coals. Finding the lid hook can be a little tricky at first but I quickly got used to it. The last drawback is lack of prep space. After using several other grills, I realized I took for granted having shelves or areas to set down food, utensils, or thermometers. Overall, this grill performs great, the food taste amazing and I’m happy I had the chance to try and review it.
Results.Title: From intimidated to loving charcoal grilling

Results.ReviewText: Built very well, cooks great, holds heat and overall very impressed. Substantially better thany last one.
Results.Title: Well Built, Cooks Very Well

Results.ReviewText: Everyone needs a portable grill like this one. The wheels are sturdy enough to maneuver over most terrain. The grill itself is a comfortable weight and size to throw into to your truck for transport. I love how the grill is big enough to grill a meal the entire day, but doesn't take up so much space. We took it out on a lake day and had such a great time with it. Thanks to our Weber, we had warm, fresh food the entire day.
Results.Title: Durable and transportable

Results.ReviewText: Weber is above and beyond. A name that speaks louder than a thousand words and I cannot be more impressed with their customer service response. But, even more so by the quality of their product that stands the rest of time, value and thank you for all of those satisfied meaningful backyard family and friend moments over and over our lifetimes. So many Americans have learned to grill on a Weber and your product will continue to bring us together. Thank you!!

Results.ReviewText: I have had several of the 22” Kettle charcoal grills. I love it, I cook on the grill at least 3-4 days a week. This grill last me about 6 years until shutter starts to fail. Not bad for as much as I use it. Very versatile from hamburgers and hotdogs to smoking brisket, pulled pork and ribs. Once you figure how to control the heat you can literally cook anything on it. This is the best grill for the price!!
